sentences.text: Order Sheet
12.09.2025 This is an office reference.
Heard Mr. Prafull N. Bharat, learned Advocate  General assisted by Mr. Shashank Thakur, learned  Deputy Advocate General, appearing for State.

In compliance to the Court's order dat  26.08.2025, the Secretary, Department of Health &
 Family Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh, has filed  his personal affidavit, relevant paragraphs of which are  quoted hereinbelow:
 "1.

entities.text:
Department of Health &
 Family Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is submitted that by way of an instant writ  petition (PIL), this Hon'ble Court has taken Suo  Moto Cognizance of the situation of outbreak  of Diarrhea in the Kharod village of District- In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44992677/
1  2 Janjgir-Champa (C.G.) due to which 23 incidents have occurred after consuming contaminated water from a local hand pump.

2. It is respectfully submitted that the matter was listed before this Hon'ble Court on 26/08/2025, and this Hon'ble Court has directed the Secretary, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, to file his personal affidavit indicating the present status of the outbreak of Diarrhea and the measures undertaken by the State to control and prevent further spread of the disease.

This Hon'ble Court further directed to list the matter on 12/09/2025.
3.
It is respectfully submitted that at the present remaining 28 patients are not showing any symptoms of Diarrhea.
The copy of the letter dated 21/08/2025 is being filed and annexed herewith as Annexure A/2 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court.
It is submitted that stool test of 5 patients have conducted and the report has been found negative and the bacterial motility is not seen.
The copy of the stool test report of 5 patients is being filed and annexed herewith marked as Annexure  3 A/3.

It is respectfully submitted that the answering respondents, of the Department of Health and Family Welfare, have taken steps to seal the polluted water resources on the basis of a door-to-door survey, and after chlorinization of the water, safe drinking water is also being provided, and health related education is also being imparted.

entities.text: Department of Health and Family Welfare
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: For example, people are being told to drink only clean water or boiled water.
Instructions have also been issued with respect to covering the food items, and to consume fresh food only.
Health-related instructions have also been given with regard to compulsorily washing of their hands before eating food and after using the toilet.
Further instructions have been given to maintain cleanliness near the home and not allow collection of water.
It is further submitted that instructions have also been given for not answering nature's call in open area and to use the toilet within the house, and to maintain cleanliness.
It is submitted that instructions have been issued to contact the nearest Health Center in case of vomiting and showing any symptoms of Diarrhea.
4. It is respectfully submitted that as on the date, no person has been detected positive as per the information of the respondent Health Department.

Herein, it would be pertinent to mention here In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44992677/
2

entities.text: Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that earlier 13 cases of Diarrhea were found in the Block Akaltara, Primary Health Center Nariyara and on the basis of symptoms one stool sample was taken in order to confirm the presence of Cholera.
However, the stool sample has been found negative for Cholera.

It is further submitted that earlier in Primary Health Center Amora, Block Navagarh, 16 cases of Diarrhea were found, and on the basis of symptoms, two stool samples were taken in order to confirm the presence of Cholera,
and both the Stool samples have been found negative.

entities.text: Primary Health Center Amora, Block Navagarh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is submitted that earlier in the Community Health Center, Kharod, Block Pamgarh, 49 cases of diarrhea were found, and on the basis of symptoms two stool samples were taken in order to confirm the presence of cholera.
However, both the stool samples were found to be negative.
Thus, the 78 patients were not showing any symptoms of Diarrhea as on the last date of hearing dated 23/07/2025.

Copy of the relevant chart for the month of July is being filed and annexed herewith as Annexure A/4.
5.
It is respectfully submitted that the State Government is taking the following measures for the prevention and control of acute diarrhoeal disease.

"1 State-level guidelines and instructions have been issued for prevention, control,
and management of seasonal infectious diseases.
(Annexure-1).
The copy of the guidelines dated 07/07/2025 is being filed herewith marked as Annexure A/5 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court.
2. Epidemic-prone and inaccessible villages have been identified, and advance arrangements have been made to ensure uninterrupted medicine supplies in such areas during the rainy season.
3. Rapid Response Teams (RRTs) have been constituted at both district and block levels for immediate response.
4 Disinfection and chlorination of drinking water sources is being carried out across all districts.
5. Testing facilities for epidemic-related diseases have been ensured in all medical colleges and district hospitals.
6. Awareness campaigns on epidemic prevention and control are being conducted at the district level.

7. A letter was issued to the Chief Medical & Health Officer, Janjgir- Champa District,
in compliance with the Hon'ble High Court's Order dated 23.07.2025 in WPPIL, by the Director of Health Services on 20.08.2025.
(Annexure-2)
. The copy of letter dated 20/08/2025 is being filed herewith as Annexure A/6 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court.

3

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Weekly feedback reports are being submitted to the State for monitoring of outbreaks 9.
A circular was issued to all Chief Medical & Health Officers on 25.06.2025 regarding preparedness for epidemic control in outbreak-affected areas.
(Annexure-3).

The circular dated 25/06/2025 is being filed herewith as Annexure A/7 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court.
10.
Acute Diarrhoeal Disease (ADD) cases and outbreaks are being regularly identified and reported under IDSP-IHIP, and prompt remedial measures are being undertaken from time to time.
(Annexure-4)
. The copy of acute diarrhoeal disease outbreak details is being filed herewith marked as Annexure A/8 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court."

Herein it would be pertinent to mention that the Outbreak is defined as a sudden increase in occurrences of a disease when the number of cases exceeds what is normally expected for a specific location or time period.
This can affect a small, localized group or a larger population.
6. It is respectfully submitted, herein, it would be pertinent to mention that earlier, the Health Department of District Janjgir-Champa (C.G.) had set up a camp in the affected area.
However, at present, no positive cases of Diarrhea have been found, and therefore, there is no necessity of setting up the camp.
Therefore, the camps have been withdrawn.
It is submitted that at present, as per the information received by the answering respondent, the situation is in control and there is no evidence of spread of diarrhea in any of the affected areas.
Thus, it is respectfully submitted that the answering respondents have taken necessary steps and the situation is under control.
Hence, it is submitted that the direction issued by this Hon'ble Court has been substantially complied with.

7. It is submitted that the answering respondents are under a duty to take necessary steps to control any situation affecting the health of the citizens and the common public whenever any such situation arises.

It is respectfully submitted that the answering respondents have immense respect for the orders and directions issued by this Hon'ble Court from time to time, and the deponent herein, is bound to comply the orders passed by this Hon'ble Court in its letter and spirit"
Perusal of the affidavit goes to show that the State Government has taken prompt and adequate measures to control the outbreak of Diarrhea in the affected areas of District Janjgir-Champa.

It is evident that polluted water sources were identified and sealed, chlorination and disinfection activities were carried out, and awareness campaigns were launched to educate the local population regarding safe drinking water, personal hygiene, and food safety.
The affidavit further discloses that stool tests conducted on the suspected patients were found negative for Cholera, and that at present, no patient is showing any symptoms of Diarrhea.

It also emerges from the affidavit that Rapid Response Teams have been constituted at both the District and Block levels, advance arrangements for medicine supply have In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44992677/
4 been made, and continuous monitoring and reporting mechanisms are in place under IDSP-IHIP.

entities.text: Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The establishment of camps in the affected areas earlier and their withdrawal after the situation came under control further indicate that the authorities have remained vigilant and responsive.
Thus, from the facts placed on record, it is clear that the situation has been effectively controlled and, as on date, there is no evidence of spread of Diarrhea in the affected region.
Considering the said fact, list the matter again on 29.10.2025 for further monitoring.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
